title: Check disk space usage
summary: Use the `df` command to see how much space is used and available on your filesystems. By default, it shows usage in 512-byte blocks, but you can switch to kilobytes for easier reading.

steps.explain: Run `df` to list all filesystems and their disk usage in 512-byte blocks.
Run `df -k` to display the same information but using 1024-byte (kilobyte) units, which is often easier to read.

alternatives.explain: Run `df -P` to display information in a portable format, which ensures consistent output across different systems.
